protocol.rationale: The initial family used the V10 rescue as a direct route and omitted its successful failure-contingent mechanism. Restore that existing baseline, preserving all initial outputs.
protocol.family: Reload every initial frozen tail unchanged; append the full archived V10 fixed-primary rescue with primary sliced by prefix length, failure_index shifted by prefix length, departures and rescue unchanged, first_action_now=False. No new nominal routing.
protocol.controls: Integrated unchanged family must match initial values; appended fixed candidate must match V10 fixed-primary upper, not V10 best across different root actions. Absolute tolerance1e-7.
protocol.policy: Same prefix and frozen grid. Choose minimum conditional expected tail upper after arrival. Cap prefix failure at the root deadline loss.
protocol.observed_diagnostic: After integration, update a fresh posterior using existing public prefix departure/arrival receipts and choose among the same frozen tails. This also handles observed off-grid seconds without reverting to candidate0; it does not renew the root certificate.
protocol.execution: All three already-declared roots once. No sample or performance replay. If a fixed-control equality fails, save that result and stop.

observed_boundary_diagnostic.source: Existing public incumbent ride receipts applied to a fresh posterior after all root evaluation; no actual future tail outcome is read.
observed_boundary_diagnostic.scope: Operational action re-evaluation only; not reuse or extension of the original root finite-grid certificate.
